"""Meridian CRM RBAC permission check."""

from typing import Any


def can(
    user: dict,
    action: str,
    object: str,
    record: dict,
    role_rows: list[dict],
) -> bool:
    """Return whether the user may perform an action on a record."""

    role_id = user.get("ROLE_ID", "")
    owner_uid = record.get("OWNER_UID", "")
    user_id = user.get("USR_ID", "")
    record_team = record.get("TEAM_CD", "")
    user_team = user.get("TEAM_CD", "")

    permission = None
    for row in role_rows:
        if (
            row.get("role_id", "") == role_id
            and row.get("object", "") == object
            and row.get("action", "") == action
        ):
            permission = row
            break

    if permission is None:
        return False

    if action == "DELETE" and record.get("DEL_FLG", "") not in ("", "N"):
        return False

    if role_id == "ADMIN":
        return True

    scope = permission.get("scope", "")

    if scope == "ALL":
        return True
    if scope == "TEAM":
        return user_team == record_team
    if scope == "OWN":
        return owner_uid == user_id
    if scope == "NONE":
        return False

    return False
